increment: Week-1 build list item 2: task_ledger.py gains a `stage` field (research->draft->critique->final, orthogonal to status). The Sequential protocol that 'Drop the Hierarchy and Roles' found beats both extremes turns out to be two primitives the ledger already had: 'visibility into prior outputs' IS a dependency (_deps_done blocks a draft until its research is done; next_stage() adds the follow-on with deps=[tid]), and 'take turns' IS a sort key (next_ready() sorts by (STAGE_RANK, created, id), so all ready research goes out before any draft). No coordinator, no turn pointer. by_stage=False restores the flat queue; a pre-392 task with no stage key defaults to research gracefully; next_stage past 'final' raises. task_ledger selftest 21 checks GREEN (+9). One transient selftest_all RED on the first post-patch run that named no failing check and did not reproduce in 10 reruns - task_ledger's own selftest (isolated tmpdir) passed 100%; likely a Windows fs race, flagged not buried. +1 node, +4 edges.
